name: Courage
q: Enter the tiger's den to catch the tiger
You can't learn without diving in
Fear is a feeling, courage a choice
Advance as much as you fear
Seek death and live; seek life and die
Cowards die many times before their deaths
Do not yield to evils; be bolder still
The bravest see the danger and go on
Fire tests gold; adversity tests the brave
I am not afraid; I was born to do this
Courage is the mean between fear and confidence
If I am upright, I face ten thousand
What does not kill me makes me stronger
Come back with your shield — or on it
